def parse_sentence(s):

    s_norm = str(s).replace("\xa0", " ")
    # Name is before Added; added date between Added and Due; due date after Due
    m = re.match(r"^(.*?)\s*Added\s+(.*?)\s*Due\s+(.*?)\s*$", s_norm, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

        return None, None, None
    name = m.group(1).strip()
    added = m.group(2).strip()
    due_text = m.group(3).strip()
    # Parse due date as a real date (as shown in existing example)
    due_date = datetime.strptime(due_text, "%d %b %Y")
    return name, added, due_date

for row in range(5, 7):
    name, added, due = parse_sentence(ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value)
    ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value = name
    ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = added
    ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value = due
    ws.cell(row=row, column=5).number_format = "yyyy-mm-dd h:mm:ss"

import os
import re
from datetime import datetime
from openpyxl import load_workbook

ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def normalize_spaces(text):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(text).replace("\xa0", " ")).strip()

def parse_due_date(date_text):
    text = normalize_spaces(date_text)
    # Per instruction, the year is always 2021; add it if it is omitted.
    if not re.search(r"\b\d{4}\b", text):
        text = f"{text} 2021"
    for fmt in ("%d %b %Y", "%d %B %Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    raise ValueError(f"Could not parse due date: {date_text!r}")

def parse_sentence(sentence):
    text = normalize_spaces(sentence)
    m = re.match(r"^(.*?)\s+Added\s+(.*?)\s+Due\s+(.*?)\s*$", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse sentence: {sentence!r}")
    name = normalize_spaces(m.group(1))
    added_date = normalize_spaces(m.group(2))
    if not re.search(r"\b\d{4}\b", added_date):
        added_date = f"{added_date} 2021"
    due_date = parse_due_date(m.group(3))
    return name, added_date, due_date

# Fill only the exact requested answer cells C5:E6.
for row in (5, 6):
    name, added_date, due_date = parse_sentence(ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value)
    ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value = name
    ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = added_date
    ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value = due_date
    ws.cell(row=row, column=5).number_format = "yyyy-mm-dd h:mm:ss"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: print the values written in C5:E6.
check_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
check_ws = check_wb["Sheet1"]
for row in (5, 6):
    print(row, [check_ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value for col in (3, 4, 5)])
